- Can you confirm the exact filename and file size of the PDF you uploaded? Ariba sometimes rejects PDFs with embedded fonts or non-standard encodings.

Kimberly / Sienna — quick note from Sales side: we've seen Ariba normalize emails for login names (dots, plus-tags removed) and in some tenants that normalization maps to an internal uniqueness check. Workarounds that have worked for other vendors:

- Create the Ariba account using a slightly different local-part (e.g., procure_novorisk@novorisk.com) then change the contact email in the profile to procure-support@novorisk.com after the account is created.
- Try a different browser or incognito mode (sometimes cached cookies / SSO fragments cause odd validation failures).

If the file is a normal PDF and still rejected, we'll escalate to Ariba support. Vanessa — can you please confirm whether our tenant currently supports PDF/A and what's the file size limit?

Hi all — I opened a case with Ariba (case ARS-20270815-3482) and included the screenshot and the PDF. Ariba Support confirmed two tenant constraints:

- Allowed upload types: PDF (up to 10 MB), PNG, JPG. However, portal validation rejects PDFs that are not linearized or that contain certain embedded fonts. They recommended re-saving as PDF/A or printing to PDF from Acrobat.
- Username normalization: our tenant applies a normalization rule that removes dots and plus-tags; the normalized username must be unique across the tenant. Support can create a manual claim/mapping if you provide a signed company-authorized email domain claim and the preferred login.

Action items:
- Sienna: please re-save the KYC as PDF/A and retry the upload; if it still fails, attach the PDF to the Ariba case thread (I've included ariba-support in this email).
- Ben/Kimberly: if we want Ariba to manually claim 'procure-support@novorisk.com' to NovoRisk, we'll need a short domain ownership attestation and the desired username string. I can draft a template if needed.

I'll monitor the Ariba case and update here. Ticket link: https://ariba-support.sap.com/cases/ARS-20270815-3482.

Thanks,
